name: Flipped Class Check-in
description: For a class that read or watched beforehand: a quick check, the misconceptions it reveals, a clarification, then class time spent applying.
audience: Flipped classrooms, homework review, after-reading discussions.

signals.why: your words describe a flipped or pre-read class

slides.guidance: {topic}: from home to class, with a subtitle naming the class.
What students will do in class today with what they read at home.
A check of the key idea from the pre-reading.
The misunderstanding students most likely brought from the reading.
The idea explained again, briefly and differently from the reading.
The main in-class task applying {topic}: instructions, minutes, grouping.
Questions that connect the task back to the idea.
What to read or watch next, and what it will be used for.
